name: Ruins of the Buddhist Vihara at Paharpur
description: Paharpur's Somapura Mahavihara, in Naogaon district in northwestern Bangladesh, is the ruin of a vast Buddhist monastery that flourished as a centre of learning from the 7th century until the 12th. Its brick cells surround a huge open courtyard, with a stepped central temple rising from the middle and walls covered in carved decoration. Its design later inspired temple building as far away as Cambodia.
